from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's report for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this report belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    expense_items: list[ExpenseItem] | None = Field(description="List of expense line items as they appear in the report")

class ExpenseItem(BaseModel):
    """One expense item reported in a financial statement."""
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The label/name of the expense item as written in the document, e.g. '管理费用'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
